id: title:Gilbert09:support help scout api version v3

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion support for Help Scout's v3 API, including authentication and pagination compatibility, alongside existing v2 support.
review.reason: The change introduces a v3 API version and base URL for the Help Scout warehouse connector, alongside existing v2 support. This expands compatibility and ingestion capability for Help Scout customers. Tests are added to verify URL construction and parameter compatibility. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and tests, but the actual benefit and adoption are not demonstrated. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow maintenance is supported. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow maintenance is supported.
